about: Real sound effects for cinetic films: links, never audio (the audio is fetched at film time by sfx.mjs into the film's audio/sfx/ with a licence record, and never committed). Each sound was auditioned with earshot (a forced choice between its role and cheap or cartoon alternatives) and measured: onset (first sample at 10 % of the peak), lead before it, peak, loudness, floor, centroid. align: onset roles put their transient on the cue frame, peak roles (whooshes, risers, swells) their loudest point. "roles" maps a kit role to the kinds that may play it; "actions" (the actions of scripts/audio/actions.py) wins where the cast names the role's action. Every sound carries heard_as and not_heard_as: the actions and kit roles its kind may play that earshot 0.4.1 heard its take as (the sound as kit.py real places it: 48 kHz, from just before it starts, at most 2.5 s, its lead-in trimmed for an onset role; z >= 2 for the best of the action's phrasings or the role's words, the forced choice against four cheap-synth descriptions won), and the ones it heard as something else; its ear is that verdict for the action it was taken for (a kind no action lists: the kit role), and a sound heard as none of them is in rejected. sfx.mjs pick plays a heard sound first and one heard as something else last. The onset, peak, end and loudness of the sounds added on 2026-11-06 are kit.py's own measure_take (loudness: the loudest 400 ms and 50 ms), lead is kit.py lead_in, floor the 10th percentile of 50 ms levels.

mixkit-sfx.name: Mixkit
mixkit-sfx.quote: Items under the Mixkit Sound Effects Free License can be used in your commercial and non-commercial projects for free.
mixkit-sfx.limits: use inside a larger work (a film); never redistribute the file on its own, as stock, in a tool or template, or with source files; never register it with a rights-management service

not_used.why: its licence allows commercial use without a credit, but its pages and downloads answer scripts with a bot check (HTTP 403 on 2026-11-04), so a film cannot fetch them without a browser and an account
downloads need an account and an API key, and many sounds ask for a credit (CC BY)
